name: Sasa
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Sasa (also spelled Shasha) is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of the tribe of Benjamin. He is recorded in the genealogical lists as part of Saul's lineage. He is a relatively little-mentioned biblical figure, but is noted as part of Benjamin's family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's family tree
keyEvents.description: Sasa is listed as one of the sons of Elpaal in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: The residences of the family heads in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Sasa's lineage is counted among the family heads who lived in Jerusalem and held leading roles within their clans.

keyEvents.title: Part of the overview of the tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Benjamin, Sasa is included in the extensive genealogical record provided by Chronicles to document the history of Israel's tribes.

keyEvents.title: Elpaal's sons as family heads
keyEvents.description: Sasa and his brothers are mentioned as heads of their families, responsible for leading their clans in the divided kingdom.
